slides.texte_overlay: Take care of your skin and hair. Wash, moisturise, get a good haircut. Simple grooming makes a huge difference without changing who you are.
Have a purpose. Goals, projects, things you're building. A man who knows where he's going is far more attractive than one drifting.
Be emotionally open. Say what you feel calmly. Men who can talk about emotions without drama are rare and deeply attractive. Laughter is a strong connection.
Be playful. Light teasing, inside jokes, a sense of fun. Seriousness all the time is tiring. Playfulness makes people want more of your time.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. A curious mind makes you more interesting than any outfit.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A curious mind makes you more interesting than any outfit.

slides.texte_overlay: Treat people with respect, especially when nobody's watching. Kindness to strangers says more about you than anything you could say.
Dress for your body. Clothes that fit, simple colours, clean shoes. You don't need expensive things, just a style that suits you.
